g.text: Cost-aware local recovery with a paid 4 s handover

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #203343

g.text: 100 simulated robots × 60 s · 8 tested confirmation sites · 32 factual runs · original fixed weights

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #516574

g.text: Ordinary legacy scoring, admission and neighbor caches are preserved in both arms. The recovery gate requires 420 available-radio silent slots.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: All three one-sided primary comparisons retain the 1 − 0.05/3 bound; both reduction lower bounds must exceed zero. Intervals: 20,000 whole-site bootstrap draws, conditional on fixed weights.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Endpoint sensitivity counts pending commands as candidate misses and reference successes. Engineering gates cover worst-decile loss, silence, original video and bulk.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Source / causal / paid completion / offline integrity: True. Measured profile exceedances remain paid capacity diagnostics.

text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #516574

g.text: Whole controller-package effects do not establish JEPA-objective necessity, hardware safety, production readiness or SOTA.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #bc4c5e

g.text: PRIOR AGGRESSIVE 4 s REPAIR FAILED DEVELOPMENT: RadioMap +5.505 pp · JEPA +4.748 pp. That result remains unchanged.
